items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So I said, "Steve, how much money do you pay for two or three dependents? How much money?"

ctx.x: So I said, "Steve, how much money do you pay for two or three dependents? How much money?" He said, "Wait, I'll tell you." So he went and got that chart there. He said "Eleven dollars." I said, "Man, give me my money."
You told him to give you your money, huh, Danny?
